what's a word like unsweep (or word unseepable)? there is no mention of "XXXXX" in the dictionary. i suppose you mean "unseepable". i would say "unseepable" is the word people would use.

a:

unseep is one of the words from the wiktionary that is not listed as XXXXX, so it must be a word you have found or heard. 
you may be interested in wordreference - a good starting point for finding words and phrases. it's not available in all languages, but it is very good to have a quick search for a word you don't know. it's also worth looking at the definition of unsweep (from wikipedia)
"a slip of the tongue (often of the tongue); a slang or vulgar term for a particular type of person, habit, art, or manner of speech.
synonyms: slip 'em, slip'em."
wikipedia has more on word definitions here.
